start.deeplink_received: 📥 Detected share code {{shareCode}}. Fetching the file for you...
help.page.overview: 📖 How to use VaultLink 🔼 Upload — send any file in chat, you'll get a share code instantly 🔽 Retrieve — paste botname:CODE to fetch a file back 💳 Credits — /credits to see your balance, top up, or earn by sharing 🆔 Your id — /uid to copy your Telegram user id ✨ Tricks • Multiple files / album in one go → auto-bundled into a Collection • Send a text during upload → captured as the description • Paste many codes in one message → delivered in order Tap a tab below to browse the commands.
help.page.files: 📁 Your files /files — list files + collections /del [CODE] — delete /set_password [CODE] [password] — set a password /remove_password [CODE] — remove the password /report [CODE] [reason] — report inappropriate content 🔐 visibility: public (everyone) / private (only you + admin)
help.page.bots: 🤖 Your bots /add_bot [BOT_TOKEN] — add a bot (default: public) /bots — list your bots /remove_bot @username — remove a bot Bot mode /mode public — 🌐 anyone can use it /mode private — 🔒 only you + allowed users User control (private mode) /allow [user_id] · /deny [user_id] /allow_upload [user_id] · /deny_upload [user_id] /stats — bot statistics
help.page.settings: 🔧 Settings & misc /settings — change language (th / en) /uid — show your Telegram user id /cancel — abort the current upload session 📄 /terms — Terms of Service 🔐 /privacy — Privacy Policy
help.page.credits: 💳 Credits /credits — your balance + history (or use the 💳 tile on /start) How to earn • 🎁 Welcome bonus on first interaction • 📤 Share your codes — earn each time someone else opens them • 💎 Top up with Telegram Stars (when enabled) • 🪙 Top up with stablecoins on TRX / BSC / ETH / TON (when enabled) Crypto top-up (Wave 9.3 — full auto) • Pick a network → token (USDT or USDC) → amount • You get a unique decimal amount (e.g. 10.000072 USDT) + a wallet QR • Just send EXACTLY that amount; the bot detects it on-chain and credits automatically — no tx-hash entry, no 19-confirmation wait • Need to redo a request? Cancel any pending invoice from the Open invoices list to free a slot How to spend • Each code-open costs credits (cost set by admin) • Opening your own code is free • Out of credits → top up, share to earn, or wait for daily refresh Open the Mini App for the full Credits dashboard with history and per-chain top-up.
help.page.admin: 🛡 Admin menu Any moderator (super admin OR bot owner) /admin_reports — pending reports /lock_file [CODE] — lock a file /unlock_file [CODE] — unlock /delete_file [CODE] — delete a file Super admin only /admin_stats · /admin_bots /ban [user_id] · /unban [user_id] /broadcast [message] /admin_credits · /admin_credit_stats /admin_credit_referral_stats [creator] [redeemer] /admin_crypto · /admin_crypto_invoice [id] Founder only (listed in ADMIN_IDS) /promote [user_id] · /demote [user_id] /super_admins — list /admin_credit_grant [tg] [amount] [note] /admin_credit_revoke [tg] [amount] [note] /admin_credit_setbal [tg] [balance] /admin_credit_set [key] [value] /admin_credit_packages_set [json] /admin_crypto_address [chain] [address] /admin_crypto_apikey [chain] [key] /admin_crypto_invoice_recheck [id] /admin_crypto_invoice_force [id] /admin_crypto_invoice_attach [id] [tx] /admin_crypto_invoice_extend [id] [minutes]
terms.body: 📄 VaultLink Bot Terms of Service 1. The service is provided as-is, without any availability guarantee. 2. Do not use the service to share content that is illegal in your jurisdiction, infringes on copyright, or harms others. 3. Administrators reserve the right to delete files, suspend accounts, or lock share codes that are reported or found to violate these terms. 4. You retain ownership of the files you upload and may delete them at any time. 5. Continued use of the service means you accept these terms.
privacy.body: 🔐 Privacy Policy • We store only what is necessary: Telegram IDs, language preference, uploaded file metadata, and usage statistics. • Personal bot tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. • File passwords are hashed with argon2id and cannot be recovered. • We do not inspect your file contents and do not share data with third parties. • You can delete your own files at any time via /files or /del.
